name: Korean peninsula
summary: No North Korean missile launch found since 3 Nov; Kim visited nuclear material production sites on 25 Nov
state: South Korea reported a North Korean launch of multiple missiles on 3 Nov, the fourth weapons launch in a month (US News). On 25 Nov Kim Jong Un visited nuclear material production facilities and a research institute, his fourth such visit since September 2024, state media reported (Korea Herald). No missile launch in the past two weeks, nuclear test or border clash was found to 26 Nov, so Normal holds.
for_you: No direct effect for most people. Travellers to South Korea should follow FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: No missile launch in 2 weeks, no border incident = Normal
